content.short: PropBase is an RWA marketplace on Aptos that fractionalizes high-quality real estate for institutional access.
content.description:
PropBase is a leading decentralized platform for tokenized real-world assets (RWAs), specifically designed to democratize access to high-quality real estate investments. Built natively on the Aptos blockchain, the protocol allows users to invest in fractionalized property assets starting from as little as $100. By converting illiquid physical properties into liquid digital tokens ($PROPS), PropBase enables participants to earn monthly rental yields and benefit from potential capital appreciation in a transparent, non-custodial environment.

Leveraging the high throughput and security of the Aptos network, PropBase provides a professional-grade marketplace for the discovery and exchange of tokenized real estate. The platform focuses on professional asset management and regulatory alignment, ensuring that every digital token is backed by verifiable physical collateral. Through its commitment to lowering the barriers to entry for property ownership, PropBase is building the essential infrastructure for a more efficient and inclusive global real estate economy, where traditional stability meets decentralized innovation.
content.meta: PropBase offers fractionalized real estate tokenization and rental yield tools on the Aptos blockchain.
